results.label: Reproduced result
results.claim: Davey Fig 10.3 latitude PDF at 00:19 (BTO+BFO, 8 x 7M particles): median 38.16S, 95% 35.91-39.53S; book 37.53S, 34.90-39.38S; overlap 71%; split-half 93%

results.label: Diagnostic/sensitivity
results.claim: stratum pooling fix (47ff1b1): shoulder 34.5-36.5S 3.5% -> 3.6%, median unchanged; complex-manoeuvres 17.7 -> 17.9%; mach-wide 10.6 -> 11.1%

results.label: Diagnostic/sensitivity
results.claim: northern shoulder deficit (book 25%): not weather, ephemeris, altitude or Mach prior, declination; sparse filters reproduce >=25% in ~1 in 7-12 runs at 7-35k particles, never at 140k; ACCESS-G test pending

results.label: New analysis
results.claim: Ulich/Boeing tables: fuel-flow factor ~ N(1.009, 0.018) from 11 in-range items (+/-6-7 min over 6 h); old public proxy over-burned Table 3 by 41%

results.label: New analysis
results.claim: placeholder, still air, log-on only, equal priors: P(before, after, powered) = 0.977/0.014/0.009 (lambda 0.1/h), 0.934/0.039/0.026 (0.3/h), 0.811/0.114/0.075 (1/h)

results.label: New analysis
results.claim: GDP replay kernels (Student-t nu, scale): GLORYS12 2.73/77 km, OSCAR2 2.62/72 km, BRAN2016 3.68/94 km; skill 0.49-0.60 vs 0.10 currents-only

results.label: Reproduced result
results.claim: Griffin & Oke: BRAN2016 endpoints from 35.6S 92.8E land 20-30 km from PHR_4

results.label: New analysis
results.claim: stand-in on 00:19 positions: Z_H 6.4e-4; P(H|D) 0.0006/0.006/0.06 at K*eta 1/10/100; given H median 36.8S, 45% in 34.5-36.5S

results.label: New analysis
results.claim: P_in(s) ~ Lambda_H(s) (median ratio 1.15-1.24): cluster positions barely discriminate impact sites in the mixed result; information is in p(s|D,H) and P(H|D)

results.label: New analysis
